module: Flowgraph node "Single Marker" (author BeamNG). Displays a race marker (scenario/race_marker) at a position with a radius. Must be reset manually (reset pin); camera-dependent transparency is only updated with a continuous flow. Marker types: overhead, ringMarker, sideColumnMarker, sideMarker, cylinderMarker, attention, sideHologramMarker, singleHologramMarker. Inputs: flow, reset, position, radius, markerType, color, fadeNearDist, fadeFarDist; output: flow.
notes: Bug: _afterTrigger tests self.shown which is never set to true: the marker is not hidden when the flow drops, only reset deletes it.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

postInit.desc: Offers the marker types as templates for the markerType pin.

hideMarker.desc: Clears the marker (clearMarkers) and forgets it.

_afterTrigger.desc: After the trigger: if flow is false and the marker is shown, tries to hide it.

fillFields.desc: Reads position (+ data.zOffset on z), radius (2 by default, 1st component if table) and color; returns true if position or radius changed.

work.desc: On reset, hides the marker; on flow, creates the marker if needed, updates it (setToCheckpoint, color, update) and sets flow to active on output.

onDrawOnMinimap.desc: Draws a circle with an edge pointer on the minimap as long as the marker exists.

onClientEndMission.desc: End-of-mission hook: cleans up the objects created by the node.

destroy.desc: Called when the node is destroyed: cleans up the created objects.
